set.body: Epic: bd-01KWW00VNSYZGKMA2NN1VFWN2J. Add portable matrix helpers needed for non-orthonormal dictionary projection: transpose, cross-products where missing, ridge-capable Gram solve, and explicit projection helpers. Acceptance: tests show orthonormal shortcuts and non-orthonormal least-squares paths agree with reference fixtures; both JVM and JS pass.
